sloka: मातरं रक्ष कैकेयीं मा रोषं कुरु तां प्रति ।मया च सीतया चैव शप्तो ऽसि रघुसत्तम ॥ २.११२.२७॥
transliteration: mātaraṁ rakṣa kaikeyīṁ mā roṣaṁ kuru tāṁ prati ।mayā ca sītayā caiva śapto 'si raghusattama ॥ 2.112.27॥

translations.english: Look after your mother, O chief of the Raghus Do not be angry with her. Swear in my name and in the name of Sita. So saying, eyes filled with tears, Rama took leave of his brother.
